name: coordinator-planned-anchoring
body:
Anchoring note for the session coordinator. `solution.container.mutation-coordinator` and its components (`session-routing`, `session-lifecycle`, `write-through-projection`) are NOT yet built, so they carry no `implemented-by` edges to session code — the plan-writer declares their real code FQNs as planned Implementation nodes (`apg plan add <project> planned …`) and the spine is wired to those at plan/reconciliation time. `solution.component.write-through-projection` is additionally anchored to the real synchronous paths it reshapes (`apg.layers.write_project`, `apg.plan_cmd.write_through`), and `session-routing` to the real read path `apg.cmd_query`. `solution.component.mutation-db-decoupling` is anchored to `apg.artifacts.code_universes`, `apg.artifacts.reingest_layers`, `apg.git.reanchor_scan_meta`, and `apg.layers.write_project`.

The coordinator is a MANDATORY deliverable, not a plan option (session-mutation-coordinator): the plan MUST realize the coordinator and its solution nodes, and the verify/coverage gate treats them as in-scope. The `prefer-structural-fix` law no longer makes them optional — it requires serialization of the whole durable sequence and justifies the coordinator by amortization of the DB open (never of visibility: projection deltas are applied write-through). The transparent direct path is additionally serialized by the extended flock (evaluate-fix-ladder option a).
